theme_archetype.name: Modified Performance Pro (Archetype 2) + Jewel & Luxury (Archetype 5)
theme_archetype.description: A high-end, dark-mode-only mobile web app (PWA). It blends tactical, command-center athleticism with premium, intimate luxury. The UI feels like an elite gym at night—dark, sleek, with strategic neon illuminations.

girly.name: Girly Intimate
girly.description: Dark base but with romantic/intimate neon highlights.

layout_spacing.container_strategy: Mobile-first wrapper: `max-w-md mx-auto w-full min-h-[100dvh] bg-[#0A0A0A] relative pb-24 shadow-2xl overflow-x-hidden`
layout_spacing.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Mode: `grid grid-cols-2 gap-4`. Use `col-span-2` for hero metrics (e.g., Next Workout), and `col-span-1` for split stats.

surface_strategies.bottom_nav: Fixed at bottom within the `max-w-md` container. `h-20 bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-white/10 flex justify-around items-center z-50`
surface_strategies.cards_neumorphic_tactile: Solid `bg-[#141414]` with `border border-white/5`. NO large drop shadows. Rely on the 1px stroke to define the shape against the black background.
surface_strategies.glassmorphism_overlays: For modals and player controls: `bg-[#0A0A0A]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10`. Must have high blur to feel premium.

buttons.primary: `w-full py-4 rounded-xl font-bold tracking-wide text-white bg-gradient-to-r from-[var(--theme-primary)] to-[var(--theme-secondary)] hover:opacity-90 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex justify-center items-center gap-2 shadow-[0_4px_20px_var(--theme-primary-glow)]`
buttons.secondary: `w-full py-4 rounded-xl font-semibold tracking-wide text-white bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all`
buttons.fab_center: The '+' tab in nav: `w-14 h-14 -translate-y-4 rounded-full bg-[var(--theme-primary)] flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-[0_8px_25px_var(--theme-primary-glow)] border-4 border-[#0A0A0A]`

components.inputs: Shadcn overrides: `bg-[#141414] border-white/10 text-white placeholder:text-zinc-600 focus-visible:border-[var(--theme-primary)] focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[var(--theme-primary)] rounded-xl py-6 px-4`
components.nav_item: `flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 text-zinc-500 hover:text-white transition-colors aria-[current=page]:text-[var(--theme-primary)] text-[10px] font-medium tracking-wider uppercase`
components.duo_feed_card: Stack partner avatars organically (`-space-x-4`). Use micro-interactions for emoji reactions floating over the card.

motion_and_interactions.press_states: MANDATORY on all buttons and cards: `active:scale-[0.98]`.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer motion is recommended: `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`.

icons_and_assets.usage_rules: Use `strokeWidth={1.5}` globally for a sharp, premium aesthetic. For the 'Girly' theme, utilize `Heart` icons heavily for likes/streaks. For 'Default' theme, use `Zap` or `Flame` for streaks.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. FRAMEWORK: Use React + Tailwind. Implement the strict mobile-first viewport layout (`max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#0A0A0A]`) so it works beautifully as a PWA and looks like a phone emulator on desktop.

2. THEME ENGINE: Set up a theme context or simply toggle a `.theme-girly` class on the root container. Map the CSS variables from the 'colors.themes' section to your Tailwind config or use arbitrary values like `bg-[var(--theme-primary)]`.
3. TYPOGRAPHY: Import and apply 'Outfit' (headers), 'Manrope' (body), and 'JetBrains Mono' (numbers/timers). Do not use Inter for headers. Maintain sharp font weights (Light, Bold, Black).

4. WORKOUT PLAYER: This is the core experience. Make the timer massive (`text-8xl`), center-aligned, using Monospace, glowing over the dark background. The controls (Pause/Play, TTS announce) should be large, thumb-friendly floating glassmorphism buttons.
5. SHADCN OVERRIDES: Strip the default white/gray Shadcn styles. Override inputs, cards, and dialogs to match the `bg-[#141414]` and `border-white/10` dark mode luxury specification.
6. DUO SPACE & PARTNER LINKING: Use overlapping avatars (negative right margin) to visually represent the couple link. Reactions should be visually distinct against the dark background.
7. TESTING: Every single button, tab, and form input MUST have a `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid='nav-workouts'`, `data-testid='theme-toggle'`).
